proposed.explanation: While Narra is culturally significant and ecologically valuable, monoculture planting lacks ecological layering and habitat diversity. Monoculture may reduce initial maintenance but creates ecological vulnerability and poor habitat value. The presence of Narra alone does not determine ecological value; the diversity and structure of the planting composition does. Design B demonstrates multiple ecological landscaping principles: layering (canopy, understory, groundcover), habitat diversity (multiple native species), and xeriscaping (native species requiring minimal water and inputs).
